selected.why_now: Over 24-36 months, Betsson's B2C-led organic growth in Latin America and regulated Europe plus B2B stabilization should return EBIT margin from the current ~16% toward the 20-22% historical range; at SEK 90.25 the reverse DCF implies only low-teens EBIT margins and near-zero or negative revenue growth, and the case breaks if EBIT margin remains below ~15% by 2027 or B2C organic growth stalls.
thesis_breaks: Reported EBIT margin remains below ~15% on a trailing twelve-month basis beyond 2027 without a clear path back to high-teens.
B2C organic revenue growth falls to low-single digits or active customers decline for multiple quarters.
B2B revenue fails to stabilize or another large B2B customer materially reduces activity.
Regulatory or tax changes further compress profitability in key locally regulated markets without offsetting growth.
The strong Q3 trading update does not translate into sustained reported revenue and margin improvement in subsequent quarters.

excluded_finalists.detail: The latest accepted analysis is not currently investable.
excluded_finalists.reconsideration_trigger: Q3 2026 report (due 20 Oct 2026) shows revenue growth above ~20% YoY, EBIT margin above ~15%, and stabilizing customer gold volume per transaction or moderating customer acquisition costs.
